label: prop:pieri-photon-shift
title: Multiplication by a degree-one Hecke element is a non-commutative Fourier shift (Pieri rule)
html:
Proposition. Multiplication by a degree-one Hecke element is a non-commutative Fourier shift (Pieri rule)

Statement. Let \gamma be a degree-one element, and let \beta_m be supported purely on the \lambda-block. The support of the product \gamma \cdot \beta_m expands strictly to partitions adjacent to \lambda in the Young lattice:

  \mathrm{supp}\bigl(\gamma \cdot \beta_m\bigr)
  \;\subseteq\;
  \{\lambda\} \;\cup\;
  \{\lambda + \square\} \;\cup\;
  \{\lambda - \square\}.
